incidents.name: MARA proxy unauthenticated swap entry point
incidents.notes: The MARA proxy exposes an unauthenticated payable entry point (selector 0x5fc985ea) that runs caller-supplied swap paths with the contract's own funds, letting the attacker skew the MARA pair inside a DODO flash loan and sell into it.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xc6a8c02dd5a3dd1616ec072bfc7c9d3df9682a63 created 2024-07-13T08:24:31Z by 0x1e28945e3be54673b632e9300ec9c8dfee0be26e, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x3026c464d3bd6ef0ced0d49e80f171b58176ce32; 4 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from last of 4 upgrade events (onchain). 8.8 WBNB x $606.53/BNB at the incident timestamp 1727196179 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $5,337.
